title: How Much Do Resume, LinkedIn and Cover Letter Services Cost?
h1: How much do resume, LinkedIn profile and cover letter services cost?
description: Starting prices for resume writing, LinkedIn profile optimization and cover letters from the sellers we feature, and why the range is so wide.
intro: Career document prices vary more than almost any other service, from the cost of a coffee to over a thousand dollars. This article shows the starting prices of the sellers we feature for resumes, LinkedIn profiles and cover letters, explains why executives and entry-level job seekers pay different amounts, and helps you pick the right level.

faq.q: Why are some resume services so expensive?
faq.a: Senior and executive packages often include interviews, strategy, several documents and long delivery times, and are written by specialists in that level.

faq.q: Is a cheap resume service worth it?
faq.a: It can be, for a simple profile, but check what is included and how many revisions you get.

faq.q: Do I need all three documents?
faq.a: Many job seekers start with a resume, then add a LinkedIn profile and a cover letter template. Some sellers bundle them.

faq.q: Are there risks with LinkedIn account access?
faq.a: Some packages have the seller log in to your account. If you choose one, change your password afterward and use a unique password.

faq.q: What should I send the writer?
faq.a: Your current resume, the kind of job you want, two or three example job posts, and a list of achievements with numbers where possible.
